summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate in maintaining reliable broadband infrastructure for modern public education, highlighting the direct impact of reduced funding on operational costs and budget constraints.  The school district emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for providing reliable broadband access to students, especially in rural areas, and urges the FCC to preserve and improve the program rather than sunset or eliminate it. The school district argues that E-Rate has been successful over the past three decades and should continue to be supported to ensure equal educational opportunities for all students.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would force districts to make difficult budget trade-offs, impacting staffing, classroom resources, and student services
claims.evidence_quote: When the cost of essential infrastructure increases, districts like mine are forced to make difficult choices about staffing, instructional programs, student services, transportation, facilities, and other priorities

claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to build connectivity necessary for modern education
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education. As our nation seeks to prepare students for college, careers, and an increasingly technology-driven economy, now is not the time to undermine the very program and related infrastructure that makes those opportunities possible.
